scripts.text:
[Thug]
*Sigh...*
What is life?
And what use
is money? ...Damn.
Damn this worthless life!
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
*Sigh...*
人生算什么？
钱又有什么用？
...该死。
这破烂人生，真他妈该死！

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Hey, kid.
What the hell
are you lookin' at?
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
喂，小鬼。
你他妈看什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Then get the
hell out of my face!
Didn't you hear me?
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
那就滚出我的视线！
没听到吗？
滚蛋！

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Hmmm...
Maybe I'll swing by the ^0000FFRogue Guild^000000 in ^0000FFParos Lighthouse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
嗯...
也许该去^0000FF流氓公会^000000逛逛，就在^0000FF帕罗斯灯塔^000000...

scripts.text:
[Thug]
I needz my money,
and they best have it...
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
老子得拿到钱，他们最好准备好了...

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Eh? You...you...?!
Hey, haven't we met before?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
咦？你...你...？！
喂，咱们是不是见过？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
..............
Awww, ^FF0000I am sorry^000000! I think I misunderstood you from someone I know.

[Markie]
I never misunderstand people...oh well, be safe anyway!
scripts.translation:
[马基]
我从来不会认错人...算了，总之祝你平安！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Yo, what are you doin'?!
You can't change your job if you got unused skill points, so use 'em all up. You bettah check yo-self before you wreck yo-self.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
哟，搞什么呢？！
还有没用完的技能点就不能转职，赶紧都用掉。
先检查清楚，省得自己搞砸。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
So what's a kid
like you doin' here?
Oh, I get it now...
The widdle boy wants
to be a ^800000Rogue^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
你这小鬼来这里干什么？
哦，懂了...
小男孩想当^800000流氓^000000啊。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
So what's a kid
like you doin' here?
Oh, I see...
Lil' cutie wants 
to be a ^800000Rogue^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
你这小鬼来这里干什么？
哦，懂了...
小可爱想当^800000流氓^000000啊。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Eh, nice meetin' you, I guess. I'm Markie, and I do work for the Rogue Guild, a philanthro-- *ahem* a ^800000feelanthropist^000000 group, as you can see. So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
呃，算是很高兴认识你吧。
我叫马基，替流氓公会做事。
我们是个慈善——*ahem* 是个^800000慈善家^000000团体嘛，你也看到了。
你叫什么？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
...{0}?
Heh heh! Cool name.
If it was dorky, we'd
make you change it,
so you're in luck.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
...{0}？
Heh heh! 名字挺酷。
要是太土，我们就得让你改名了，算你走运。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
So why you wanna join up with the Rogues? I guess you gave me your real name, so you'd be an honest Rogue. Not many of those around, heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[马基]
怎么想来当流氓？
你报的应该是真名吧，看来还挺老实。
老实的流氓可不多，heh heh~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Rule number 1 for Rogues...
Never give out your real identity to most people, most of the time. It's just a little backup measure we like to use.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
流氓的第一条规矩...
一般情况下，别随便向人透露真实身份。
这算是我们给自己留的一条后路。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Right. I'm officially accepting your application, so now you gotta take a test. Don't sweat it, this first one is real simple.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
好，你的申请正式受理了，现在得参加考核。
别紧张，第一关简单得很。

[马基]
好的...
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
You again?
Okay, you probably screwed up last time 'cuz you were way too nervous. So just chill and pass
this test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
又是你？
上次大概是太紧张，才搞砸了吧。
放松点，这次把考核过了，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Go talk to Smith. His test might be pretty hard. He's one of the guys who makes sure that people pay up their debts to us. So yeah, he might be a bit of a hard case.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
去找史密斯吧。
他的考核可能挺难。
他专门负责催人还清欠我们的债，所以可能有点难对付。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Yeah...
That guy can be pretty anal, but we need a guy like him in our guild. Anyway, be careful. Lots of luck to you, pal.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
是啊...
那家伙特别爱较真，不过公会也需要这种人。
总之，小心点。
祝你好运，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Heh heh...
Fresh meat. This'll be
a cinch to--Wait! Er, I wasn't talkin' about you! I meant the other fresh meat~
scripts.translation:
[马基]
Heh heh...
新来的肥羊，这下可好——等等！
呃，我可不是说你！
我说的是别的肥羊~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Oh hey, it's you!
You did a good job, guy.
Now, lemme change your
job to Rogue. You earned it!
scripts.translation:
[马基]
哦，是你啊！
干得不错，伙计。
现在就让你转职成流氓，这是你应得的！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Oh! It's you!
You were actually able to put up with that guy? Good stuff! Must've had a rough time collect all those items, eh?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
哦，是你！
居然能忍得了那家伙？
有你的！
收集那些东西够辛苦的吧？

[马基]
恭喜~！
你这模样酷毙了！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Hey hey~
Congrats!
You've been
doin' a great job~
scripts.translation:
[马基]
Hey hey~
恭喜！
你表现得很棒~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Now...
It's time
for me to make
a speech~ *Ahem*
scripts.translation:
[马基]
现在...
该我发表一番讲话了~ *Ahem*

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Enjoy your freedom as a Rogue. Just remember that you gotta be free and responsible at the same time. So treat other guys the way you wanna be treated, kay? Alright, seeya round.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
好好享受当流氓的自由吧。
不过记住，自由归自由，该负的责任也得负。
想让别人怎么待你，就怎么待别人，懂了？
好，回头见。

scripts.text: Hold on, I need to get ready!

[Markie]
Get ready...?
Fine, fine.
Take your sweet
time, why don't you?
But hurry up and
come back, got it?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
还要准备...？
行，行，你还真是不着急啊。
不过赶紧回来，听见没？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Listen carefully, and
pick the right answer.
Capish? Now, lemme
read these questions...
scripts.translation:
[马基]
仔细听，选出正确答案。
懂了没？
来，我念题了...

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. Choose the skill necessary for learning ^880000Stalk^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
1. 选择学习^880000潜遁^000000所需的技能。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. In comparison to the Merchant's Level 10 ^880000Discount^000000 skill, how much more of a discount, in terms of percent, can a Rogue get with Level 10 ^880000Haggle^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
2. 和商人的10级^880000低价买进^000000相比，流氓的10级^880000强制减价^000000能多便宜几个百分点？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. What is the correct description for the skill, ^880000Mug^000000?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
3. 关于技能^880000偷钱^000000，下列描述正确的是？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. How many Rogues does it require to activate the skill, ^880000Slyness^000000?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
4. 发动技能^880000流氓天国^000000需要几名流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the skill that you can learn at Level 5 ^880000Divest Helm^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
5. 学会5级^880000卸除头盔^000000后，可以学习哪个技能？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. Choose the skill which allows its user to move while hiding.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
6. 哪个技能能让使用者在隐匿状态下移动？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. Choose the card that increases the accuracy rate of its owner.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
7. 哪张卡片能提高命中率？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. Choose the monster that receives more damage when it's attacked by a weapon with the Vadon card (20 % more damage on Fire property).
scripts.translation:
[马基]
8. 用插有螃蟹卡片的武器攻击，以下哪种魔物会受到额外伤害？
（对火属性魔物的伤害增加20%。）

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. How much SP does the skill ^880000Double Attack^000000 require when used with a Dagger?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
9. 使用短剑时，^880000二刀连击^000000消耗多少 SP？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the most efficient dagger to use in the Byalan Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
10. 在拜兰地下城使用哪种短剑最有效？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. Which monster drops a slotted Gladius?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
1. 哪种魔物会掉落有插槽的长柄短剑？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. Which monster drops a slotted Main-Gauche?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
2. 哪种魔物会掉落有插槽的笨拙短剑？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. Choose the class that is able to create unique potions.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
3. 哪个职业能制作特殊药剂？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. Choose the weapon that Rogues aren't allowed to use.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
4. 哪种武器是流氓不能使用的？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the property that the monster Hode possesses.

[Markie]
6. Choose the monster that is unable to be tamed for as a Cute Pet.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
6. 哪种魔物不能驯养成宠物？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. Choose the monster that receives more damage from a Dagger with the Fire property.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
7. 以下哪种魔物受到火属性短剑攻击时，伤害会更高？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. Choose the town that doesn't have any guild castles.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
8. 哪个城镇没有公会城堡？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. Choose the plant that drops Blue Herbs.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
9. 哪种植物会掉落蓝色药草？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the monster that does not have the Undead property.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
10. 以下哪种魔物不是不死属性？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. By what percentage is the flee rate increased when a Thief masters the ^880000Improve Dodge^000000?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
1. 盗贼将^880000残影^000000学满后，回避率提高百分之多少？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. Choose the monster that detects a characters using the Hiding or Cloaking skill.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
2. 哪种魔物能发现使用隐匿或伪装的角色？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. Choose the location where Thieves can change their jobs to Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
3. 盗贼在哪里可以转职为流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. In which town can Novices change their jobs to Thieves?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
4. 初心者在哪个城镇可以转职为盗贼？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the card that does not affect the DEX stat.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
5. 哪张卡片不会影响 DEX？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. So what's cool about being a Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
6. 当流氓有什么酷的？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. When is it possible to change jobs from Thief to Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[马基]
7. 什么时候可以从盗贼转职为流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. You want to dye your hair blue. What town do you go to, and in which direction, with 12 o' clock being North.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
8. 想把头发染成蓝色，该去哪个城镇的哪个方向？
以12点钟方向为北。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. Choose the mushroom that is required on the Thief job change quest.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
9. 盗贼转职任务中需要哪种蘑菇？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the card that least benefits the Rogue class.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
10. 哪张卡片对流氓的帮助最小？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Let's see.
You got...
{0} points.
Good. You passed.
We don't gotta
do that again.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
让我看看。
你得了...{0}分。
不错，通过了。
不用再考一遍了。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Let's see.
You got...
{0} points.
Aw crud... You failed!
scripts.translation:
[马基]
让我看看。
你得了...{0}分。
啧，糟了...没通过！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
But don't get too comfortable just yet, you got more o' these tests. Your next one will be from Smith.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
先别高兴得太早，后面还有考核。
下一关找史密斯。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
So...
Go find Smith and finish up this test, yeah? Be careful though, Smith's a pretty anal guy.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
所以...
去找史密斯，把考核完成吧？
不过小心点，那家伙特别爱较真。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Man, you shoulda learned more when you had the chance. Thanks for wasting my time.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
伙计，有机会的时候就该多学点。
真是谢谢你，白白浪费我的时间。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
*Sigh...* Lemme give you some tips, yeah? I'm supposed to tell you about some kind of ^990000iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000 to help you learn what you need to know.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
*Sigh...* 给你点提示吧？
上头让我告诉你什么^990000iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000，说能帮你学到该懂的东西。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Of course, I don't know what the heck it means, but if you understand it, it'll probably help you out a lot.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
当然，我也不知道那玩意儿到底是什么。
不过你要是懂，大概能帮上不少忙。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Whoa, slow down newbie. We only accept people who are at least Thief Job Level 40. I ain't risking myself by letting you in before you're ready. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
Whoa，先别急，新来的。
我们只收盗贼职业等级至少40的人。
你还没准备好，我可不敢冒险放你进来。
懂了？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Huh...?
What's an Assassin doin' here? Uh, you haven't been assigned to kill someone in the Rogue Guild, are you?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
嗯...？
刺客来这里干什么？
呃，你该不会是奉命来杀我们公会里谁的吧？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
In any case, don't mess with us! You can't catch me... I'm a smooth criminal!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
总之，别惹我们！
你抓不住我...我可是个身手利落的惯犯！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Don't get it, huh? It's something I always used to say to Huey. If you're in the Assassin Guild, you oughta have met him...
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
没听懂？
这是我以前常对休伊说的话。
你在刺客公会，应该见过他吧...

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Hey hey~
Long time no see.
Eh, right now we don't
any requests from the
guild for you, so just
check back again later.
scripts.translation:
[马基]
Hey hey~
好久不见。
公会现在没任务给你，过阵子再来看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Hey you...
Get your ugly
ass out of here
before I redecorate
that face of yours!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会成员]
喂，你...
赶紧滚出去，不然老子就把你那张脸揍得改头换面！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Welcome to
the Rogue guild.
From here on, I will
verify your qualification.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
欢迎来到流氓公会。
接下来，由我检验你的资格。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Before we get started,
I want you to know
about something...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
开始之前，先告诉你一件事...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
All new Rogues are required to pay an application fee, so I hope you take care of that first.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
所有新加入的流氓都得交报名费，希望你先把这事办好。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What you have to understand is that the Rogue Guild does a lot of business, ^666666sometimes illegally^000000, that needs financial backup.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你得明白，流氓公会有很多生意，^666666有时候不太合法^000000，都需要资金支持。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我会告诉你的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know......
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我会告诉你的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know........
By the way.....
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我会告诉你的...
顺便说一下...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Oh man...
This is...
Damn...
Annoying!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
真是的...
这...
该死...
烦死了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Today, I'm in a pissed off mood, ya' know why?! I haven't collected any bills! God! Idiot Thieves coming at me all the time, wanting to become Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
今天老子火大，知道为什么吗？！
一笔钱都没收上来！
该死！
那些蠢盗贼还一个接一个地跑来，说要当流氓！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Jesus! Now I understand why our leader told us that working as customer support sucks.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
天哪！
现在我算懂了，为什么首领说做客服真他妈难受。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That god damn guild master assigned me to this shitty job. I'm better than this F$@king job!
That bastard should go to F$@king hell, I'm gonna kick that mother F$@kers ass! F#%k F#%k F#%k !!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
那个该死的会长把这破差事丢给我。
老子的本事，哪该干这F$@king破活！
让那混蛋下F$@king地狱去吧，老子要踹烂那个F$@kers的屁股！
F#%k F#%k F#%k !!!

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That dipshit who just tried to change his job, the one before you...
You know what the f#@k he talked to me about?!?
F#$@%#$*#$%@#$!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你前面那个来转职的蠢货...
你知道他跟我扯了什么f#@k玩意儿吗？！
F#$@%#$*#$%@#$!!

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the--?! What's with this chat filter?! Stop #*!@$ing me! you stupid F#$%*! Let me talk!!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么——？！
这聊天过滤器搞什么鬼？！
别再#*!@$ing我了！
你这蠢F#$%*！
让我说话！！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the f#@k you looking at...? {0}? That's your name!?
 
[{1}]
Umm...
Sir...?
I didn't mean to make you upset. I just came here to so I could become a Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你他f#@k看什么...？
{0}？你叫这个名字？！
 
[{1}]
呃...
先生...？
我不是故意惹你生气的。
我只是来转职成流氓。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Holy shit on a stick, what the f#$k was I just f!#king talking about, you moron!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他妈的，老子刚才说了什么f#$k话啊，你这蠢货！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Just leave me alone! Just leave alone! Just leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
别烦我！
别烦我！
别烦我！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Do whatever you want, okay? Just do whatever the F$!!K you want...!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
爱干什么就干什么，行了吧？
你他F$!!K爱怎么着就怎么着...！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Crysalis^000000!
^FF00005 Empty Bottle^000000!
^FF00005 Iron Ore^000000!
^FF00005 Stone Heart^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Red Herb^000000!
^FF00005 Animal Skin^000000!!
^FF00005 Yellow Gemstone^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Tooth of Bat^000000!
^FF00005 Scorpion Tail^000000!!
^FF00005 Yoyo Tail^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Feather of Birds^000000!
^FF00005 Talon^000000!!
^FF00005 Spawn^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
Don't even think about coming back until you've got all those or I'll kill you where you stand.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
没把这些东西都弄齐之前，别想回来，否则我就把你当场杀掉。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the F$@k? Did you just say I'm annoying you? Shut up, you ungrateful prick!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么F$@k？
你说我烦你？
闭嘴，你这不知好歹的混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I just added ^FF000010 Raccoon Leaf^000000 to the list. You better get it!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
清单上再加^FF000010片变身叶子^000000。
最好给我弄齐！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
F%$#*&#@$%#@$@#$%@$%&*k! Haven't you ever thought about how hard it would be to be an NPC!?!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
F%$#*&#@$%#@$@#$%@$%&*k! 你想过当 NPC 有多难吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Three thousand, two hundred seventy two. Three thousand, two hundred seventy three. Three thousand, two hundred seventy four...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
三千二百七十二。
三千二百七十三。
三千二百七十四...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Uhh...
Headache...
This is too much
zeny to count.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
呃...
头疼...
这么多 Zeny，数都数不完。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Uh...?
What are you doing here? If you're going to talk about the job change, you need to speak to the other guy first.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...？
你来干什么？
要办转职，先去找另一个人。

[史密斯先生]
...该死！
我数乱了！

[史密斯先生]
嗯...让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Wow, you've brought each and every single thing I asked you to. Good work... I salute you.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
哇，我要的东西你一样不落地全带来了。
干得不错...向你致敬。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Since you showed such great effort, I'm going to write a recommendation letter for you. I usually don't do that, you know.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
看你这么卖力，我就给你写封推荐信。
平时我可不干这事。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
But I'm sure you'll be a great asset to the Rogue Guild. Hmm, I don't have a blank piece of paper right now, so take this instead...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
不过，你肯定能给流氓公会帮上大忙。
嗯，手头没空白纸，先拿这个代替吧...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
*Sigh...*
I know, I know. I'm supposed to control myself in the work place. Getting enraged is a bad habit...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
*Sigh...*
知道，知道，工作时该控制情绪。
动不动发火确实是个坏毛病...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
*Mumble mumble...*
How was I... *Mumble...*
How did... I remember...
*Sigh* It was all because of my bad temper!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
*Mumble mumble...*
我刚才怎么... *Mumble...*
怎么会...想起来了...
*Sigh* 都怪我这坏脾气！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt might be a better
idea to come back later.^000000

[Mr. Smith]
Listen this time!
Application fee:
^FF000010000 zeny^000000,
^FF00005 Crysalis^000000!
^FF00005 Empty Bottle^000000!
^FF00005 Iron Ore^000000!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Stone Heart^000000!!
^FF00005 Red Herb^000000!
^FF00005 Animal Skin^000000!!
^FF00005 Yellow Gemstone^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Tooth of Bat^000000!
^FF00005 Scorpion Tail^000000!!
^FF00005 Yoyo Tail^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Feather of Birds^000000!
^FF00005 Talon^000000!!
^FF00005 Spawn^000000!!
^FF000010 Raccoon Leaf^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
Don't even think
of coming back
without them!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
没带齐就别想回来！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Let me see...
Who would should
I send you to...?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
让我想想...
该让你去找谁呢...？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Right! I know
just the guy~!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
对了！
我知道该找谁了~！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go visit Aragham Junior who lives South of the Sandarman Fortress. That area is located one field east from here.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去找住在桑达曼要塞南边的小阿拉甘。
从这里往东走一个地图，就是那一带。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He's a pretty nice guy, you know. He works hard and is really good at bill collecting.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他人挺不错，干活卖力，收债也很在行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Before he joined the Rogue Guild, people have been trying to kill him for something his father did in the past. So, he became a runaway.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他父亲以前做过些事，惹得人们一直追杀他，他只好四处逃亡。
那是在他加入流氓公会之前。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Well anyway, that's why he's been with us. We've been helping him hide from his enemies.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
总之，他就是这样加入我们的。
我们一直帮他躲避仇家。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password if you want to meet him. He doesn't let anybody in his house without the password.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
想见他，最好记住暗号。
说不出暗号，他不会让任何人进门。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
暗号是^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Well, I will wish you luck. His place isn't that far from here, so come back as soon as possible. Being swift... That is the spirit of the Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
祝你好运。
他住得不远，尽快回来。
行动迅速...这就是流氓的精神。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...
This guy might be
good for you, but...
He's a little dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...
这个人也许适合教你，不过...
他有点危险。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I want you to meet Antonio Junior, son of Antonio the first. For some reason people have been trying to kill him because of something his father did in the past.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去找小安东尼奥，他是老安东尼奥的儿子。
他父亲以前做过些事，不知为何一直有人因此想杀他。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He was brought up in Payon, but he's staying in an empty house near the Kokomo beach at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他是在斐扬长大的，但现在住在克克魔海边的一栋空房子里。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I've heard lately that he's been complaining a lot about the noise outside of his house, and he fears an assassination attempt. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
最近听说，他总抱怨屋外太吵，还担心有人要暗杀他。
总之...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He's kind of tense, so he throws a dagger at anyone who approaches his house. He has a violent personality.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他神经紧绷，谁靠近他家，他就朝谁扔短剑。
脾气挺暴躁。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
However, he does have magnificent business skills. And he also loves gambling. Once you get to know him, he'll take care of your Rogue training really well.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
不过，他做生意很有本事，也喜欢赌博。
等熟悉了，他会好好指导你的流氓训练。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password to meet him in person. The password is ^0000FFAntonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
想当面见他，最好记住暗号。
暗号是^0000FFAntonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...
This guy might be
good for you, but...
He's a little dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...
这个人也许适合教你，不过...
他有点危险。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
His name is
Hollgrehenn Junior,
a genius at manipulation.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他叫小霍尔格雷恩，是个操纵人心的天才。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
However, because of something his father did long ago, people have been trying to kill him. Because of this, he is very high strung and will throw daggers at people he doesn't trust.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
不过，他父亲以前做过些事，一直有人因此追杀他。
所以他神经特别紧绷，会朝不信任的人扔短剑。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Our leader has been able to get him to join our guild, and his brilliant mind has been an asset to us. Once you get to know him, he'll take care of your Rogue training really well.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
首领成功说服他加入公会，他的聪明才智帮了我们不少忙。
等熟悉了，他会好好指导你的流氓训练。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password to meet him in person. The password is ^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
想当面见他，最好记住暗号。
暗号是^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Alright... Now that I've calmed down, I can inform you of your next destination. *Whew*
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好...
现在我冷静下来了，可以告诉你接下来该去哪了。
*Whew*

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go and find Hermanthorn Junior, who is living near the ^0000FFthe checkpoint of Paros Lighthouse^000000, which is at the border between Morocc and Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去找小赫曼索恩。
他住在^0000FF帕罗斯灯塔检查站^000000附近，就在梦罗克与克魔岛的交界处。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah...almost forgot, keep in mind not to mention anything about upgrading items. This is very important.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊...差点忘了，千万别提精炼物品的事。
这点很重要。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么...？
你说忘了该去哪？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Head one field East and enter the building that is South of the Sandarman Fortress to meet Aragham Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
往东走一个地图，进入桑达曼要塞南边的房子，找小阿拉甘。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
暗号是^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么...？
你说忘了该去哪？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go to the building
at Kokomo Beach,
which is on the way
to Comodo, to meet
Antonio Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去克克魔海边的房子找小安东尼奥。
那里就在去克魔岛的路上。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FF'Antonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
暗号是^0000FF'Antonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items'^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么...？
你说忘了该去哪？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go to the field South of Sandarman Fortress, which is on the way to Morocc from here, to meet Hollgrehenn Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去桑达曼要塞南边的野外找小霍尔格雷恩。
那里在从这里前往梦罗克的路上。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
暗号是^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmmm...?
Don't you have
to go somewhere
else to complete
your Rogue training?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...？
你不是还得去别处完成流氓训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
First, the
application fee:
^FF000010,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
首先，报名费：
^FF000010,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...?
What was that?
Did you just say that
you're willing to donate
more for the guild?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...？
你说什么？
愿意多给公会捐点？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That sounds sweet,
I appreciate that.
But come back when
you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
那可真不错，多谢了。
不过，还是等你准备好再来。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Okay, we've got the application fee, ^FF000010,000 zeny^000000, {0} {1}, {2} {3}, {4} {5} and {6} {7}...

[Mr. Smith]
Great, great...
I think you
brought everything.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
很好，很好...
看来都带齐了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Alright, wait just a moment while
I prepare these things. Let's see... Your next test is...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好，稍等，我先把这些东西处理好。
让我看看...你的下一项考核是...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the f$@k!? You didn't bring all the required items?! Are you telling me that you need to check the requirements again!?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什么f$@k？！
你没把东西带齐？！
还要再核对一次要求，是吧？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Now listen...!
Bring ^FF000010,000 zeny^000000,
and the following items...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
听好了...！
带来^FF000010,000 Zeny^000000，还有以下物品...

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
谁在那儿？！
谁敢闯我的地盘？

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
谁在那儿？！
谁敢闯我的地盘？

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
谁在那儿？！
谁敢闯我的地盘？

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
I see...
You must be from
the Rogue guild.
You must be one of the
ones Mr. Smith wasn't
too happy with...
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
原来如此...
你是流氓公会派来的吧。
看来也是让史密斯先生不太满意的人之一...

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
He threw a fit and you brought him all the items he asked for, didn't you? Well, I can see that you're still pretty naive. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
他发了顿脾气，你就把要的东西全给他弄来了，是吧？
看来你还真够天真的。
Hahaha~

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
I suppose he suckered you into gathering those items, and then passed you on to me. Sad, really.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
他骗你收集完那些东西，就把你推给我了吧。
真可怜。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Well, since you were tortured by him, I'll try to be especially generous to you. My test for you will be simple, so simple.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
既然你已经被他折腾过，我就格外宽容些。
给你的考核很简单，特别简单。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
All you have to do is go through an underground tunnel, and walk all the way back to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
只要穿过地下隧道，一路走回流氓公会就行。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
There is one thing I should tell you, though. You might want to be careful inside, alright?
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
不过有件事得提醒你。
在里面小心点，好吗？

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
A bunch of pricks have been throwing Dead Branches and casting Hocus Pocus all over the place...
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
一群混蛋在里面到处折枯树枝、施放随机技能...

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Well...
Just make it back to the Rogue Guild alive. That's all you have to do!
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
总之...
活着回到流氓公会，就算过关！

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Oh right. This is really important. You need a password to enter the tunnel. To unlock the door, the four number combination is ^0000FF3019^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
哦，对了，这点很重要。
进隧道得输密码，开门的四位数字是^0000FF3019^000000。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Huh...?
What the hell
are you doing here.
Scram, why don't you?
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
嗯...？
你他妈在这里干什么？
还不快滚？

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked. You'll need to enter the four number combination to open it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF门锁着。输入四位数字密码才能打开。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt didn't work. Please re-enter the four number combination.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF密码不对。请重新输入四位数字密码。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFPlease enter a combination of four numbers.^000000

[HermanthornJr.]
Well...
Didn't I tell you
that I changed the
password? *Wink Wink*
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
哎呀...
我没告诉你密码改了吗？
*Wink Wink*

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Oh, you must be
from the Rogue Guild...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
哦，你是流氓公会派来的吧...

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
My name is
Aragham Junior,
Rogue of the Desert.
Are you ready to learn
how to be a Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
我叫小阿拉甘，人称沙漠流氓。
准备好学习流氓的本领了吗？

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
See, as a Rogue, our motto is, '^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000' That rule especially goes true for monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
听着，流氓的座右铭就是“^0000FF避开强者！欺凌弱者！^000000”
对付魔物时尤其如此。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Avoid the strong!
Be malicious to the weak!
It's a simple rule...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
避开强者！
欺凌弱者！
规矩就这么简单...

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Now, remember it as you go through ^0000FFthe Underground Tunnel^000000. Try to walk all the way to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
穿过^0000FF地下隧道^000000时，把这话记牢。
试着一路走回流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
There will be a few monsters, but don't worry. I know you're strong. Alright, are you ready to go or what?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
里面有些魔物，不过别担心，我知道你有本事。
好了，准备出发没有？

[小 阿拉甘]
好的...
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Fine, fine.
Take your time
and come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
好，好。
慢慢准备，好了再来。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Oh, you're back.
I think you'll do well this time. Another motto Rogues have is '^0000FFFailure teaches success^000000.' Well, then again...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
哦，回来了。
这次应该能做好吧。
流氓还有句座右铭：“^0000FF失败乃成功之母^000000”。
不过，话又说回来...

[小 阿拉甘]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Fine, fine.
Take your time
and come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
好，好。
慢慢准备，好了再来。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Huh...?
Who are you?!
You're not from
the Rogue Guild!!
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
嗯...？
你是谁？！
你不是流氓公会的人！！

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
You've come here to kill me, haven't you? N-no! I'm can't die yet! Get lost! Otherwise, I'll kill you first!
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
你是来杀我的，对不对？
不、不行！
我还不能死！
滚开，不然我先杀了你！

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Hey...
what brings
you back here?
Why don't you
take a rest
before you leave?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
嘿...
怎么又回来了？
走之前不休息一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh...
From the
Rogue guild, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
嗯...
流氓公会派来的？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
I'm Hollgrehenn Junior. I tend to a lot of our underground business. So are you ready to take on my test?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
我是小霍尔格雷恩，负责不少地下生意。
准备好接受我的考核了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
We Rogues share this motto: ^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000 This rule applies to any threat, especially monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
我们流氓的座右铭是：^0000FF避开强者！欺凌弱者！^000000
对付任何威胁都适用，尤其是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
It's easy to remember.
Just don't forget to put it into practice. You got it?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
很好记吧。
别忘了照着做，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
For my test, you'll go through the ^0000FFUnderground Tunnel^000000. Follow it all the way back to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
我的考核是让你穿过^0000FF地下隧道^000000，沿路走回流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
There are some monsters there, but that'll be part of your training. Now, are you ready to go or not?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
里面有些魔物，不过这也是训练的一部分。
现在，准备出发没有？

[小 霍尔格雷恩]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Take your time.
Come back here
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
慢慢准备。
准备好了再来。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh.
You failed.
Gonna try again?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
嗯。
没通过啊。
要再试一次吗？

[小 霍尔格雷恩]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Take your time.
Come back here
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
慢慢准备。
准备好了再来。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh...?
You're not from
the Rogue Guild...
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
嗯...？
你不是流氓公会的人...

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
You better get out
of here right now
if you know what's
good for you...
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
识相的话，就赶紧滚出去...

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Now...
Beat it before
I change my mind
about killing you.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
现在...
趁我还没改主意杀你，赶紧滚。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Hey...
Come to visit?
We Rogues gotta
stick together, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍尔格雷恩]
嘿...
来看我的？
我们流氓得互相照应，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You're from
the Rogue guild?
If you wanna learn
about becoming a Rogue,
then shut up and stay put.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
流氓公会来的？
想学流氓的本领，就闭嘴待好。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000 That's our motto for battling monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
^0000FF避开强者！欺凌弱者！^000000
这就是我们对付魔物的座右铭。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Show no mercy when you fight weaker monsters, and try to keep away from stronger monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
对弱小的魔物别留情，对强大的魔物则尽量避开。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Now, I want you to walk all the way to the Rogue Guild through this ^0000FFUnderground Tunnel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
现在，穿过这条^0000FF地下隧道^000000，一路走回流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
There are monsters there, but if you avoid the strong and be malicious to the weak, you'll be fine.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
里面有魔物，不过只要避开强者、欺凌弱者，就不会有事。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I hope you do
not fail this test
You can only become
a Rogue if you pass...
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
希望你别搞砸。
只有通过考核，才能成为流氓...

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I don't have time
to fool around with
you. Hurry up, get
ready, then take
the test.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
我没空跟你耗。
赶紧准备，参加考核。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You failed...?
I guess that's life.
Are you gonna try
again or what?
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
没通过...？
人生就是这样吧。
还要再试一次吗？

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Remember, I'm doing
you a favor here...
Now, don't come back
until you're a Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
记住，我这可是在帮你...
没当上流氓，就别回来。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I don't have time
to fool around with
you. Hurry up, get
ready, then take
the test.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
我没空跟你耗。
赶紧准备，参加考核。

scripts.text:
Huh...?
Who are you?!
You're not from
the Rogue Guild!!
scripts.translation:
嗯...？
你是谁？！
你不是流氓公会的人！！

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You've come here to kill me?! I won't let you!! Come on, give me your best shot! You can't fight if I rip out your eyes!
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
你是来杀我的？！
休想！！
来啊，有本事就动手！
挖掉你的眼睛，看你还怎么打！

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Hey, how's it goin'?
Take it easy, and just
relax before you leave.
scripts.translation:
[小 安东尼奥]
嘿，最近怎么样？
放轻松，走之前休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
^F08080Tah dah~
Monsters for the
Rogue Job Change
have been reset^000000.
scripts.translation:
^F08080Tah dah~
流氓转职考核的魔物已重置^000000。
